counterexample.note: Tick 50 is set in the same bitmap word below tick 100, so the repair falls back to the old search and skips tick 100. The walk gives 1500 - 1000 = 500, but the active liquidity at tick 0 is 0.

summary: Keeps an aligned, initialized start tick only when it is bit 0 of its word or no lower bit in the same word is set. When another initialized tick sits below it in the same word, the start tick is still skipped.
